```{r setup}
library(lavaan.pl)
```

Example taken from test files. Need to edit.

```{r}
# p = number of items, q = number of latent variables, n = number of observations
p <- 30; q <- 8; n <- 1000

# Thresholds of each item
thr <- c(-1.5, 0, 1.5)

# Simple loading structure, identified by marker loadings
model <- set_latpl_model(build_constr_mat(P = p, Q = q, STRUCT = "simple"), STDLV = FALSE)

# Random loadings, latent correlations and latent standard deviations
set.seed(123)
Load <- gen_loadings(CONSTRMAT = model$CONSTRMAT, STDLV = FALSE)
R <- cov2cor(crossprod(matrix(rnorm(q * q), q)) + diag(q))
D <- diag(exp(rnorm(q, -.25, .1)))
S <- D %*% R %*% D

# True parameter vector, in the order of theta_names()
theta <- par2theta(model, list(thresholds = rep(thr, p), loadings = Load, latent_correlations = S))
length(theta)

dat <- sim_data(SAMPLE_SIZE = n, LOADINGS = Load, THRESHOLDS = thr, LATENT_COV = S)
head(dat)
```
